violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM AT START OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' NO EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY OBSERVED AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH COPY. PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND HAVE EACH SIGN A COPY., MAINTAIN SIGNED COPIES ON SITE FOR REVIEW BY THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH COPY. PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND POST FOR USE WHEN NECESSARY.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. EMPLOYEE WAS OBSERVED RINSING HANDS AND PLACING GLOVES ON WET HANDS TO SERVE CUSTOMER (NO HANDSOAP OR PAPER TOWELS WERE USED).
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO DISCARD GLOVES AND USE PROPER HANDWASHING PROCEDURES OF WASHING WITH SOAP, RINSE AND DRYING WITH PAPER TOWELS BEFORE APPLYING CLEAN GLOVES.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED MAXIMUM WATER TEMPERATURE OF 89F AT HANDWASH SINKS IN FRONT SERVICE AREA AND BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE ENSURE MINIMUM WATER TEMPERATURE OF 100F AT HANDWASH SINKS ARE PROVIDED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION IN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink IN BACK KITCHEN NEAR 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PLEASE ENSURE DISPENSER IS REPAIRED OR PAPER TOWELS ARE PROVIDED AT HANDWASH SINK BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: TUNA SALAD AT 44F AND ROAST BEEF AT 45F IN COLD RAIL (RIGHT) IN FRONT SERVICE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED TUNA SALAD AND ROAST BEEF DURING INSPECTION. SUBWAY (Inspection Date: 02/28/2025) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 DOOR UNDER COUNTER UNIT IN FRONT SERVICE AREA AT 51F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED TCS FOODS TO WALK IN REFRIGERATOR DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE REPAIR REFRIGERATOR AND DO NOT USE UNIT TO STORE TCS FOODS UNTIL REPAIRED AND ABLE TO MAINTAIN FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW. ENSURE REFRIGERATION UNITS ARE ADJUSTED TO OPERATE BETWEEN 34-38F TO ENSURE TCS FOODS CAN BE MAINTAINED AT 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: CHEMICAL SANITIZER DISPENSING SYSTEM IS NOT OPERATING TO DISPENSE SANITIZED AT APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATIONS.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EDUCATION PROVIDED. STAFF MANUALLY ADDED SANITIZER TO 3 COMPARTMENT SINK TO ADJUST TO APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE REPAIR IMMEDIATELY OR BEFORE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. ENSURE SANITIZER CONCENTRATION IS OF APPROPRIATE LEVEL 200-400 PPM (QUATERNARY AMMONIA) BEFORE SANITIZING CLEANED DISHES.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: OBSERVED TEMPERATURE AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK AT 89F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE MINIMUM WATER TEMPERATURE AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK IS 110F BEFORE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit IMMEDIATELY OR BEFORE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.
